entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Urza's principal stronghold and workshop in the Kher Ridges during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Builder of the tower and of machines to fight his brother.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad whose magic tended the mitab vines.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Organized a crusade against Urza's former base.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: Installed the Temporal Anchor and defenses at the tower.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Joined the planeswalkers at the tower.

entities.name: Saheeli's Temporal Anchor
entities.description: Device installed and activated in the tower's eastern wing.

events.summary: The Church of Tal crusade smashes the remaining machines in the tower but cannot damage its structure, and moves on toward Mishra's Forge.
events.quote: the crusaders instead moved on toward Mishra 's Forge

events.summary: Teferi, Saheeli and Kaya visit the tower, finding it desolate but sound.
events.quote: its interior was desolate but structurally sound

events.summary: The planeswalkers, joined by Jodah, install and activate Saheeli's Temporal Anchor and defenses.
events.quote: installed and activated Saheeli 's Temporal Anchor in the tower's eastern wing

relations.quote: Urza constructed the tower as a place of seclusion
to continue his conflict with his brother, Mishra
